text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! I'm so happy, I could explode!
That was
the best festival eveeer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop crying! Whoever thought up
gathering
all these Umadols into one
amusement park is a
certified genius!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm hungry... I guess while I was
practicing my light stick moves I should
have been eating. Ugh,
I really need to
get something in my belly...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ohhhh, a figure as insanely
beautiful as
that can only be...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't we go to the same school?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Yooogkljsh! She's actually talking to
me! She
knows I exist! Eeeeek!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Are you here to watch my spontaneous

photoshoot?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I only announced it a second ago... How
are fans
showing up already?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't believe my agency when they
told me
about the plan, but I have to do
my best,
regardless.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Anyways, my manager's waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What? Huh? WHAAAT?!
Waitwaitwaitwait! I can't
process all this
information!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhhh!
I can't go eat at a time like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Agnes Digital takes
advantage of the unexpected
opportunity and goes to support another
of her oshis. Thanks to the unexpected 
simp ses—high intensity workout, she
manages to get back in shape.
